_comment: Without colour (notes/strange-words-plan.md 4). On the air it is the drain -- the whole Age seen in grey,
every frame, the monochrome step written on purpose. Aimed at anything else that holds a colour it bleaches
that thing white: a white sun, pale grass, clear water. A colourless Age does all of it, and under the drain
the white is only ever seen as the palest grey.
Told apart from `grey`, which paints and builds: this takes colour away rather than choosing one.
